name: 狸花猫
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make a SIX KEYFRAME animation sheet for picking up and putting down THIS EXACT desktop pet cat. Preserve the reference cat's breed, coat colors, markings, eye color, ear shape, head proportions and pixel-art style. THREE columns by TWO rows, 1536x1024, equally sized cells with large padding. Each full cat including ears paws tail fits inside its cell. GENUINE transparent alpha background, opaque flat pixel clusters, no floor, no shadows, no glow, no text, no numbers, NO HAND and no person.
Row-major sequence:
1 TOP LEFT PICKUP: cat torso becoming upright, front paws lifting, hind paws just leaving imaginary ground, ears alert, relaxed curious face. Clearly a lift, not a jump.
2 TOP MIDDLE SUSPENDED: full cat hangs vertically, FOUR paws visibly dangling separately below body, hindlegs extended downward, tail hangs loosely, shoulders supported by an invisible gentle hold, no hand or collar. Natural harmless cartoon pet pickup, no distress.
3 TOP RIGHT SUSPENDED variation: SAME hanging posture, same head/body size and alignment, only tail tip and paws shift subtly, relaxed eyes blink gently. Must still be fully airborne, never seated.
4 BOTTOM LEFT TOUCHDOWN: hind paws meet imaginary ground, knees bend, front paws reach toward ground, body lowers.
5 BOTTOM MIDDLE CUSHION: all paws near ground, body crouched slightly to absorb landing, tail settling.
6 BOTTOM RIGHT SEATED: back to calm normal seated posture closely matching reference, front paws together on ground, tail beside body.
The suspended poses must be truly distinct from seated poses: elongated upright body, visibly hanging paws, uncurled rear legs. Keep single character identity across all six. Consistent logical pixel size, restrained palette, clear leg silhouettes. Cat: 狸花猫
